name: io.github.JonasHeinickeBio/pyeuropepmc
title: PyEuropePMC
description: Europe PMC search, query linting, batch lookups, full text, status and export for AI agents

environmentVariables.name: PYEUROPEPMC_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level, written to stderr: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

environmentVariables.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Raises the Semantic Scholar rate limit used by citation_snowball and the semantic_scholar source of unified_search; without it requests are throttled and may get HTTP 429.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables the LLM-powered tools (analyze_citations, literature_review, paper_screening, ...) with any OpenAI-compatible API. Needs the agentic extra.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API for the LLM tools.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Model for the LLM tools.

environmentVariables.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your contact e-mail address, sent with each Unpaywall request (their terms ask for one). Needed by the find_open_access tool only; there is no default.
